events.description: Creation of the initial rectangular step function f_1(x) with a tracing glow dot.
events.clip_query: A rectangular step function is plotted on a coordinate system with a glowing dot tracing its path.

events.description: Transition to a dual-axes layout, moving the original graph to the top and introducing a second set of axes below.
events.clip_query: The coordinate axes shrink and move to the top, and a second set of axes appears at the bottom.

events.description: Sliding window moving average animation showing the convolution process.
events.clip_query: A shaded vertical window slides across the top graph to generate a smooth convolution curve on the bottom graph.

events.description: Iterative generation of higher-order convolutions with plateau highlighting, braces, and f(0) value tracking.
events.clip_query: A yellow line highlights the flat top of the convolution curve, labeled with a brace, while the value of f(0) is tracked on screen.
